newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle quiet, few steady trades - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle quiet, few steady trades - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers rather quiet, as the bulk of this week's business already completed; but few scattered sales were steady.
Buyer inquiry continued good. Showlists now well depleted.
Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300: few loads $68.00, load choice 69.00; dressed basis 109.00.

Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs: few loads 68.00; dressed basis 109.00. Sales Confirmed:1,200 Last Week: 20,300 Last Year: 3,200 For week: 94,400 SmPd Lst Wk: 46,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr:62,500
